name: Red Sea
subtitle: Baseline inbound play
goal: Everyone scatters out of the stack, and 1 runs through the open space for a layup.
options: First: 1 streaking to the basket. Backup: 4 in the strong-side corner.

steps.note: 3 inbounds under the basket. In one line in front of 3: 4 and 5 on the block, 2 at the second lane mark, and 1 at the top of the key.
On "break", 4 and 5 split in opposite directions: 4 to the corner on our side, 5 to the short corner on the far side. 2 goes up and screens for 1 just above the elbow.
1 streaks off the screen straight down the line of the stack to the basket, into the space everyone just left.
3 reads it: 1 at the basket for the layup first, then 4 in the corner.
